title: Boutique retail plan
goal: Let a shopper understand the shopfront, merchandise displays, fitting rooms, checkout queue, and stock access before entering.

rubric.must: The entrance and two large shopfront windows are visibly arranged along the customer-facing wall.
Perimeter shelving and multiple freestanding island clothing racks are both clearly visible.
An enclosed fitting-room block visibly contains three separate fitting-room symbols.
The checkout counter has a labeled clear queue area that does not overlap any display fixture.
A labeled stockroom with shelving is visibly connected to the sales floor by a door.
Visible aisles remain around the display islands and provide a clear route from entrance to fitting rooms and checkout.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all six rules more explicitly, with three fitting-room symbols, unmistakable island clothing racks, and a labeled keep-clear queue area.
